architecture.supabase: auth + relations + permissions + light metadata only
architecture.heavy_data: Cloudflare R2 or the storage destination chosen in MSS Storage Center

features: Native organization navigation integrated into BottomNav
Organization routes: home, agenda, members, teams, competitions, rankings, admin
Settings remains the create/join/configure entry point
Creating or joining an organization enters its native workspace
Organization groups are exposed as linked read-only views in the individual Teams store
Linked organization teams cannot be deleted locally
Organization routes are hash-persisted and survive refresh
Organization team synchronization is deferred to browser idle time to protect Android navigation performance
rebase_note: Rebased on V58. All five pre-existing files touched by V3 were byte-identical between V56 and V58 before applying the patch, so no V58 changes are overwritten.
